Class Database

java.lang.Object
ipossa.Database
final class Database extends Object
SQLite-backed service layer for the IPOS-SA subsystem.

This class owns schema creation, seed data, authentication sessions, merchant/account logic, catalogue management, ordering, invoicing, payment handling, reporting, and non-commercial application processing for the prototype.

  • Method Details

    • bootstrap

      void bootstrap() throws SQLException
      Initializes the database schema and seeds the database with default data.

      This method enables foreign key enforcement, creates all required tables if they do not already exist, and then populates the database with any default records needed for application startup.

      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs while creating the schema or seeding data

    • login

      Map<String,Object> login(String username, String password) throws SQLException
      Authenticates a user by username and password and creates a new session token.

      If the credentials are valid and the account is active, any existing sessions for the user are removed, a new session is stored, and the returned map contains the authenticated user's identity, role, optional merchant details, and any account warnings.

      Parameters:
      username - the user's username
      password - the user's password
      Returns:
      a map containing the login result, including a session token and user details
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • getSession

      Map<String,Object> getSession(Headers headers) throws SQLException
      Retrieves the current authenticated session and returns the same shape used by login.

      The session token is resolved from the request headers. For merchants, the response also includes merchant details and account warnings. For administrator and manager roles, the response includes low-stock warnings used by the dashboard.

      Parameters:
      headers - the HTTP headers containing the session token
      Returns:
      a map containing the authenticated session details
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • listUsers

      List<Map<String,Object>> listUsers() throws SQLException
      Retrieves all users from the database ordered by username.

      The returned list contains one map per user, with the selected user fields converted from the result set into a JSON-friendly structure.

      Returns:
      a list of user records
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • createUser

      Map<String,Object> createUser(Map<String,Object> body) throws SQLException
      Creates a new user record in the database.

      The user is inserted with the provided username, password, role, optional merchant association, active status, and the current timestamp.

      Parameters:
      body - a map containing the user data to persist
      Returns:
      a map containing a success message
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • updateUser

      Map<String,Object> updateUser(String username, Map<String,Object> body) throws SQLException
      Updates an existing user record identified by username.

      Only the fields present in the provided body are updated; missing fields keep their current values. If no user exists for the given username, an exception is thrown.

      Parameters:
      username - the username of the user to update
      body - a map containing the fields to update
      Returns:
      a map containing a success message
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • deleteUser

      Map<String,Object> deleteUser(String username) throws SQLException
      Deletes a user record identified by username.

      If no matching user exists, an exception is thrown.

      Parameters:
      username - the username of the user to delete
      Returns:
      a map containing a success message
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • authorize

      Database.AuthContext authorize(Headers headers, String... allowedRoles) throws SQLException
      Verifies that the current request is authenticated and has one of the allowed roles.

      The session token is resolved from the request headers, and the resulting authentication context is returned only if the user's role matches one of the permitted roles.

      Parameters:
      headers - the HTTP headers containing the session token
      allowedRoles - the roles permitted to perform the operation
      Returns:
      the resolved authentication context for the current session
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • listMerchants

      List<Map<String,Object>> listMerchants(Headers headers, Map<String,String> query) throws SQLException
      Retrieves merchants visible to the current user, optionally filtered by a search query.

      Merchant users can only see their own merchant record, while other roles can see all merchants. When a non-blank query is provided, the results are filtered by merchant ID, name, email, or account status.

      Parameters:
      headers - the HTTP headers containing the session token
      query - the query parameters used for filtering results
      Returns:
      a list of merchant records
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • getMerchant

      Map<String,Object> getMerchant(Headers headers, String merchantId) throws SQLException
      Retrieves a merchant record by merchant ID and includes its current account warnings.

      Merchant users may only access their own merchant account; other roles may access any merchant.

      Parameters:
      headers - the HTTP headers containing the session token
      merchantId - the merchant identifier to look up
      Returns:
      a map containing the merchant details and warnings
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • createMerchant

      Map<String,Object> createMerchant(Map<String,Object> body) throws SQLException
      Creates a new merchant account and its associated merchant user in a single transaction.

      The merchant record is inserted first, followed by a linked user account with the MERCHANT role. If either insert fails, the transaction is rolled back so no partial data is persisted.

      Parameters:
      body - a map containing the merchant and user details to create
      Returns:
      a map containing a success message and the created merchant ID
      Throws:
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs

    • updateMerchant

      Map<String,Object> updateMerchant(String merchantId, Map<String,Object> body) throws SQLException
      Updates an existing merchant record identified by merchant ID.

      Only the provided fields are changed; omitted fields keep their current values. If the request includes discount plan fields, the merchant's discount plan is updated as well.

      Parameters:
